policy: External sources motivate equations, ranges, and falsification tests only. No external result is treated as SFR-2 evidence.

sources.title: Improved formulas for fusion cross-sections and thermal reactivities
sources.citation: H.-S. Bosch and G. M. Hale, Nuclear Fusion 32 (1992) 611
sources.use: D-T Maxwellian thermal reactivity fit already implemented in the repository

sources.title: International Stellarator Confinement Scaling 2004
sources.use: empirical energy-confinement reference only; not a dynamic-compression or ignition solver

sources.title: On miniature ultra-high-field commercial stellarator reactors with breeding external to resistive coils
sources.use: external precedent for exploring pulsed 10-20 T, small-volume stellarator architectures; not validation of SFR-2

sources.title: The science of compressional heating on the LM26 magnetized target fusion experiment
sources.use: experimental evidence that radial compression can heat/densify magnetized plasma; geometry and confinement concept differ from SFR-2

sources.title: Overview of the Helios Design: A Practical Planar Coil Stellarator Fusion Power Plant
sources.use: reactor-scale high-field and aspect-ratio context; no Helios performance is imported into SFR-2
